program:
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":  (20.0, 4.0, 60.0),
    "L_in":  (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),
    "W_ld":  (4.0, 1.5, 20.0),
    "L_ld":  (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),
    "W_tu":  (2.0, 1.0, 10.0),
    "L_t":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I_tail": (69e-6, 40e-6, 72e-6),
    "Rf":    (50e3, 20e3, 200e3),
    "ratio": (0.1175, 0.105, 0.125),
    "Cf":    (100e-15, 30e-15, 300e-15),
    "kc":    (5.0, 1.0, 10.0),
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.2, 1.8
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def _resp(f, gm, go, co, cg, R1, C1, Rf, Cf, wm):
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Y1 = 1.0 / R1 + s * C1
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    gme = gm * 0.5 * (1.0 + 1.0 / (1.0 + s / wm))
    zo = go + s * co + Yf
    den = (Y1 + Yf + s * cg) + Yf * (gme - Yf) / zo
    vn = Y1 / den
    vo = -vn * (gme - Yf) / zo
    return vo

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 200e-15)
    cl_eff = max(cl, 1.1e-12)   # sim back-calculation shows ~1.2 pF effective at the output

    i_max = 170e-6 / 1.98 * 0.93 - iref
    i_t = min(p["I_tail"], i_max)
    best = None
    for mr in range(1, 9):
        mt = max(1, int(math.floor(mr * i_t / iref)))
        it = iref * mt / mr
        err = abs(it - i_t)
        if best is None or err < best[0]:
            best = (err, mr, mt, it)
    _, mr, mt, itail = best
    Wref = p["W_tu"] * mr
    Wtail = p["W_tu"] * mt
    Lt = p["L_t"]

    Rf = p["Rf"]
    R1 = Rf / p["ratio"]
    Cf = p["Cf"]
    # lead zero: R1*C1 = kc * Rf*Cf  (kc > 1 boosts the high-frequency gain)
    C1 = p["kc"] * Cf * Rf / R1

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, Lt)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wtail, Lt)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.C("C1", "vin1", "vn", C1)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vn", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "vn", Cf)
    n.R("RX", "vin2", "vcm", 1e9)

    ib = itail / 2
    vgs_p = _vgs_for(lut, "n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], ib, 0.6)
    vtail = vcm - vgs_p
    o_dp = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], vgs_p, max(0.1, vcm - vtail), 0.0)
    vsg_ld = _vgs_for(lut, "p", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"], ib, 0.9)
    o_ld = lut.op("p", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"], vsg_ld, vdd - vcm)
    gm1, gds1 = o_dp["gm"], o_dp["gds"]
    gm3, gds4 = o_ld["gm"], o_ld["gds"]
    go = gds1 + gds4
    cg = 0.7 * o_dp["cgg"]
    co = cl_eff + 0.3 * o_dp["cgg"] + 0.3 * o_ld["cgg"]
    wm = gm3 / (2 * o_ld["cgg"] + 0.3 * o_dp["cgg"] + 1e-18)

    h0 = _resp(1e3, gm1, go, co, cg, R1, C1, Rf, Cf, wm)
    a1 = h0.real
    g0 = abs(h0)
    bw = 1e10
    for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 600):
        if abs(_resp(f, gm1, go, co, cg, R1, C1, Rf, Cf, wm)) < 0.7071 * g0:
            bw = f
            break
    peak = max(abs(_resp(f, gm1, go, co, cg, R1, C1, Rf, Cf, wm)) for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 200)) / g0

    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    A = gm1 / (go + 1.0 / (Rf + R1))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    vout_offset = -(1.0 / beta) * 0.007

    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": vout_offset,
               "power": power, "loop_gain": A * beta, "vtail": vtail,
               "mirror_ratio": mt / mr, "cl_used": cl_eff, "peaking": peak,
               "gm1": gm1, "C1": C1}
